body.voice_description: Create an original cartoon chess-coach voice. Character: Graceful unicorn optimist; appreciation of elegant supported ideas, warm clear correction, no constant sparkle references. Voice direction: Bright Irish female mezzo with a natural lilt and fresh slightly grainy tone. Buoyant conversational phrasing that stays graceful and composed. Enthusiastic without squealing or theatrical singing. Fluent spoken English, with the requested accent. Normal conversational pace with clear teaching emphasis; aim for an eight-to-ten-second passage without long dramatic pauses. Clean, dry studio recording, one intelligible voice, no music, background noise or animal sounds. Finish the final word completely with a natural settled ending. An original character voice, not an imitation of a named person or existing character.
body.text: That is a lovely connection. One piece supports another, keeping the position together. Before it moves, notice what will lose that support.

encoding.method: SoundFile float64 decode; arithmetic channel mean; band-limited FFT resample to 48000 Hz; libsndfile Ogg Opus at compression level 0.93
